rules.rank_replacement: When promoting remove previous stage; keep one active rank
rules.no_luckperms_required: FTB Library/Quests Stage Rewards as stage flags; does not itself guarantee scoreboard/chat/name tag prefix
rules.progress_model: Beständige, einmalige Story-, Berufs-, Entdeckungs- und Boss-Meilensteine; keine repetitiven Daily/Weekly-Farmränge
rules.avoid_quest_count_grind: Kein Zwang alle 2000 Quests abzuschließen; exakte Gesamt-Zahl und Meilensteine erst nach Erstellung aller Kategorien festlegen
rules.group_vs_player: Rang pro Spieler vergeben, auch bei gemeinsamem FTB-Teamfortschritt separat testen
rules.reward_claim: Autoclaim der Stage-Belohnung nach Questabschluss prüfen; sonst bei manuellem Abholen klar kennzeichnen

eligible_locations: Existing modded generated structures and dungeons
eligible_enemies: Confirmed existing boss NPCs/entities in the modpack
dungeon_and_boss_policy.selection_later: Use current modpack server registry, modlist, entity IDs, spawn conditions, and existing structures when implementing the boss quest section
dungeon_and_boss_policy.avoid_assumptions: No fabricated entity IDs or boss names and no implicit assumption that ordinary EasyNPC dialogs are real boss mobs
dungeon_and_boss_policy.evidence_and_anti_abuse: Kill trigger if supported, or confirmed advancement/loot/token task; prevent duplicate one-off rank awards
